snippet.title: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
ESCAPE ACADEMY 2: BACK 2 SCHOOL IS NOW AVAILABLE on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5! 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3296060/Escape_Academy_2_Back_2_School/

Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/escape-academy-2-back-2-school/9p743p6195q5

PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019469

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School is the sequel to the award-winning Escape Academy and expands on the beloved puzzle-solving experience of the original with an open world, explorable campus filled with hidden traps, secrets and mind-bending puzzles. Playable in its entirety solo or with loved ones, via splitscreen or online co-op.
